news.title: Hassett pivots to possible 'Trump cards' amid credit card interest rate battle with banks
news.description: Trump called for banks to cap credit card interest rates at 10%, an idea that has been roundly rejected by industry executives and their lobbyists this week.

news.title: Trump floats new tariffs in push to acquire Greenland
news.description: The comments show Trump considering applying his aggressive tariff strategies to his efforts to acquire Greenland.

news.title: Biggest offshore wind project in U.S. to resume construction after judge lifts Trump suspension
news.description: Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind will resume construction after a federal judge on Friday temporarily lifted the Trump administration's suspension.
